notes.title: Patch 1.02
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 1.02
This patch will not reset leaderboard scores

Experimental Arcade Mode
A new mode with modifier/power-up pickups for each road. This mode is marked as "experimental" as the set of modifiers/powerups and what they do is still under development. Since this mode is experimental leaderboards for this mode will be reset every patch.
Current Modifiers/Power-ups

 2x Points - coins picked up on a road with this modifier will result in 2x the points. E.g. a road with this modifier with three roads total will get six points for picking up a coin.
 Slo-Mo - a road with this modifier will spawn objects at half the normal rate and objects will move at half speed.
 Coin Spree - all spawned objects will be transformed into coins for 10 seconds.

Modifiers do not stack and picking up another one will remove the previous. Crashing will also remove that road's modifier.

Gameplay Changes
Roads now have an indicator at the top of the road showing what lane the ship is currently in.

Windowed mode
There is now a fullscreen/windowed toggle in the settings menu. This was (and still is) togglable with the F11 key.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Patch Notes 1.01
This patch will not reset leaderboard scores

Bug Fixes


 When four roads are active the road-spawning coins are converted to normal coins thus giving more of an incentive to maintain four active roads. There was a bug where this conversion only happened cosmetically i.e. a normal coin would be seen but the effect of road-spawning coin would be triggered  when overlapped by the ship. This bug has been fixed.

Balance Updates


 Max game speed of two roads has been increased by 20%
  Focusing on only two roads felt a little too easy. A 20% increase in speed will introduce a bit more risk to this strategy without making it unmanageable. 
 For reference, the following max game speeds by number of roads:
[olist]
[1] 8.0
[2] 4.0 -> 5.0
[3] 3.0
[4] 2.5
[/olist]
